verdict.rationale: Kommo publishes a documented CRM API reference that gives developers programmatic access to CRM data, with concrete methods such as batch-adding leads and linking incoming leads. A live, machine-readable llms.txt API documentation index was confirmed by probe. Webhooks can also be managed via the API. missing for 10: no published OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths 404), no independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage, and no evidence on authentication or rate-limit details.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: CRM API is a set of programming tools that allows developers to access client's data and other important information within the CRM and use it to create unique solutions.
The method allows you to add leads with contacts and a company to your account in batches.
This method allows linking an incoming lead to an existing lead.
Webhooks allow users to subscribe to certain events (such as a contact change or a new task) in Kommo, either manually or via API.
